title: HOW MONARCH BUTTERFLIES FIND THEIR WAY TO MEXICO
caption: Monarchs are moving toward Mexico this October. 🦋 #MonarchButterfly #Migration #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: How can a monarch butterfly this fragile travel thousands of miles toward Mexico?
narration_timeline.scene: Close, authentic wild monarch, introducing a single fragile traveler.

narration_timeline.text: Its journey begins when an adult emerges from a chrysalis, ready to feed and fly.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic monarch butterfly emergence, not a fabricated time-lapse of a different species.

narration_timeline.text: That adult feeds on nectar, building the energy needed for a long southbound flight.
narration_timeline.scene: Wild adult monarch sipping nectar; second wild adult as support.

narration_timeline.text: Sunlight and an internal clock help monarchs hold a heading as the seasons change.
narration_timeline.scene: Wild monarch flight; orientation explained in narration, no fabricated navigation graphic.

narration_timeline.text: This October, observers reported monarchs reaching northern Mexico during the ongoing fall migration.
narration_timeline.scene: Archival monarch on wildflowers, explicitly not represented as 2026 Mexico footage.

narration_timeline.text: So those tiny wings can lead to Mexico's winter forests, where monarchs sometimes land right on visitors.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic 2025 El Rosario sanctuary close visitor/butterfly moment around 31s; monarch visibly on visitor's face; label archival and do not imply 2026 field footage. Review final framing for prominent butterfly.
